structure.unit: Boundary Adjustments and Changes of Status of Counties, Cities and Towns
Immunity of Counties or Parts of Counties From City-Initiated Annexation and City Incorporation

law.text: The purposes of this chapter are: (i) to provide complete immunity from annexation and incorporation of new cities for those counties or tier-cities which by reason of their population density and numbers are providing urban services and (ii) to provide a system by which portions of counties may receive immunity from annexation and incorporation of new cities in the future if qualified pursuant to this chapter.
